findings.finding: Subject drifts: it opens 'its own subject: the method' then the method discovers 'its own going on' (the old discovered the method itself); name the method as what is discovered.
findings.proposed_new: A method has its own subject: the method. Co-unrelationing discovers relating; relating is co-unrelationing; and discovering that is co-unrelationing again, a method co-recursioning, its own subject, discovering the method in its going on, that discovering discovering it again, going on with each scale, possibly existing and unique. A method floats as its own subject, going on and discovering the method by going on.

findings.finding: 'floats whole of each instance' is unclear and loses 'showing no instance'; 'its subject already its own' loses that the subject is the method itself; 'where a method floats' is a where.
findings.proposed_new: Each existing thing already relates, and a method finds its subject already the method, floating free of each instance landing it. A method, a naming, floats showing no instance: an instance a self shows lands one case and thins each other case floating, a fixing setting at a method's floating. A method goes on as a wide self-cohering naming, one with each scale, a fractal its name floats whole.

findings.finding: 'its rate unique' became 'its rate its own', losing the uniqueness claim (1.1/Part 3 key word; 2.7 gives each scale a rate of its own, so 'its own' is not the same claim); restore 'unique'.
findings.proposed_new: A method floats between deriving and deploying. Deriving, as numbers, branches and sequencing, a method is unrelationing its own fixings. Deploying, as naming, explaining and resolving, a method brings one same unrelationing to a between. Deriving is-not landing and deploying is-not landing; a method floats as a middle they co-recurse around, invisible, its rate unique, discovering its going on by going on and floating free of a pointing.

findings.finding: 'with each other observing' changes the other: 3.1 tests whether any other could come and sustain, not other observings; 'each thing that is-not coming' is clumsy.
findings.proposed_new: A method reaches its own observing by a test a self brings with each other that could sustain, and a test is of an observing, apart from a survey of each thing that is-not coming. Exhausting alternatives is a closing total, and a resolving floats free of one.

findings.finding: 'Nothing of it remains to vary' became 'Its whole is-not varying', a different claim (a whole not varying, not no fixing left to vary); 'sets nothing' is a floating nothing, 2.2 says a place staying open.
findings.proposed_new: A self going on with this method reaches a changing free of a frame, a floor and a magnitude, loosens three fixings, tests with each observing, and leaves each fixing's place open. A fixing to vary is-not there, and a rival varying a frame, a floor or a magnitude lands there, not changing. An is-not empties with an observing, and uniqueness sustains to a next.

findings.finding: 'whole or none, landing one landing its form' is clumsy and loses the 'since' link; the second reason also drops the grounding 'all eight are living conditions' link.
findings.proposed_new: Uniqueness is here twice: whole or none, as landing one lands its form; and no-other, as all eight are each living form's own conditions, apart from this form's private conditions.

findings.finding: 'what' stands four times (What is true, What matters most, what a self knows it knows / does not know) with 'what' dead in resolving; mention them as quoted questions and quadrant terms, which hold whole.
findings.proposed_new: “What is true”: a binary edge, is-or-is-not with each momentary. “What matters most”: a geodesic, the straightest way a surface divides toward. The fewest things with the fewest people in the shortest time: a self-bounding, co-discovering local geodecity. Bi-inversioning off a store of “what a self knows it knows” and a first-principles authority-cut, these are three activities of one resolving, and taking them one and then the other, round, is resolving, a linearizing triangle rotating sequentially. And a quadrant of “what a self knows it does not know” is a double-double bubble-bubble going on, two binaries bi-coupling across, changing or not-changing with now or with next, each changing opening a middle from a now-existing same-existing, possibling next-existing same-existing, before it, with now and again with next; “what a self does not know it does not know” is an open corner a self's going on rides toward and leaves open.

findings.finding: The since-link is dropped: 'and a reaching opening positions a gathering cones over, a gathering is the place...' runs two clauses together; 'comes to its increase' reads as the reaching increasing, against 'constant' (old: a reaching comes to something only through a gathering).
findings.proposed_new: A self reaches and a self gathers, and the two come unlike. A reaching with an observing returns its sensing, complete with that observing, and its reaching comes with a next as it is. An observing a self gathers comes with a next changing for better: coning back over it, taking it again from its far side, gathering it whole. A reaching's competency stands constant with each observing and a gathering's climbs, and a reaching opens positions a gathering cones over: a gathering is the place a reaching comes to something. A growing climbing-plant tip sweeps wide circles until touching a support, then its circles tighten and it winds around the support as it grows.

findings.finding: 'wanting' reads as desiring, and 'scatters for want of anything else to do' became 'wanting a gathering', a shifted claim; say lacking.
findings.proposed_new: A discovering ungathering scatters, its going on lacking a gathering; a gathering undiscovering folds, lacking a new thing to cone over. A self needs both, and one increases.

findings.finding: The 'so' link (local, therefore the second stands on the first) is weakened to 'and'; 'and is-not pooling or storing' has no clear subject after the long participle clause.
findings.proposed_new: And a gathering is local and immediate. It is-not waiting on a gathering set and is-not waiting on a threshold, coning over an observing it has: a second observing with one between stands on the first, competency climbing with the rate observings come, apart from a rate a store grows, and a gathering is-not pooling or storing.

findings.finding: 'a surface sharing a purchase with it at none' has no clear 'it'; 'failing to bi-couple' makes a new verb; 'a surface is its own' is unfinished (old 'holds itself' = whole of itself).
findings.proposed_new: A self co-chains an open surface, and with inseparating it stays whole. Inseparating is a bi-coupling passing and a sharing failing to seat dissolving, a surface a failing sharing finds a purchase on at none, freedom living as inseparating and a method adding a gate at no place. A bi-coupling co-chains through; a sharing failing to seat dissolves with a collar; and a surface is whole of its own, inseparating with each between.

findings.finding: 'inseparating parts it' contradicts the name (inseparating) and 'a purchase on at none' is hard to read; 'sorts' was rightly dropped (3.8 calls sorting a discard).
findings.proposed_new: An open surface takes each sharing, and inseparating answers it by bi-coupling, a bi-coupling passing through and a sharing failing to seat dissolving. Freedom lives as inseparating, a surface being a living form where a mis-sharing finds a purchase at none, safety its own surface and a method adding a gate at no place. A gate stands with an observing edge, a fixing setting outward of its form; inseparating is with each collar, a method's own form, a bi-coupling passing as it seats and a sharing dissolving as it fails.

findings.finding: 'what makes inseparating available is that nothing fixes' (a condition) became 'available as each thing floats' (weaker link); 'fixing nothing has nothing to defend' keeps two floating nothings.
findings.proposed_new: And inseparating goes with each thing floating, unfixing. A fixing thing is the thing each coming can damage, and an accounting with one defends rather than observes, a gate coming with a way in. A self unfixing observes, and a fixing to defend is-not there: each thing coming loosens a fixing or dissolves with a collar, one or the other.
